fusions.name: Mudslide
fusions.desc: Hurls a sodden clot of mud that deals 14 damage to the first enemy it meets and knocks it back 2 tiles. The hit has a 60% chance to leave it [Soaked] for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Hailstone Barrage
fusions.desc: Drops 6 hailstones spread apart, each dealing 8 damage and ignoring resistances.

fusions.name: Soaking Mantle
fusions.desc: Restores 16 health to you and every ally within 4 tiles.

fusions.name: Runoff Recovery
fusions.desc: When you are hurt by anything but fire, you regain 3 health a second for 5 seconds. Once every 12 seconds.
